metadata.title: Deformations of harmonic maps with conical singularities
metadata.abstract: We study the deformation theory of harmonic maps with isolated singularities between compact Riemannian manifolds, in the case where all the tangent maps are smooth (away from the origin) and the decay to the tangents is polynomial. We will refer to these as conically singular harmonic maps. Under certain conditions on the Morse index and the nullity of the tangent maps and a non-degeneracy assumption on a weighted kernel of the Jacobi operator, we prove that such harmonic maps persist under a small $C^2$-perturbation of the background metric. In the second part of the paper, we construct examples of conically singular harmonic maps satisfying the assumptions of our deformation theorem. We first prove that the desired conditions on the tangent maps are satisfied by the radial projections $\mathbb{R}^m \setminus \{0\} \to \mathbb{S}^{m-1}$ ($m \geq 4$) and the complex Hopf fibrations $\mathbb{C}^{n+1} \setminus \{0\} \to \mathbb{CP}^{n}$ ($n \geq 1$). We then construct explicit examples of conically singular maps $\mathbb{S}^{m} \setminus \{N,S\} \to \mathbb{S}^{m-1}$, $\mathbb{S}^{4} \setminus \{N,S\} \to \mathbb{S}^2$ and $\mathbb{CP}^2 \setminus \{[0:0:1]\} \to \mathbb{CP}^1$ which are harmonic and satisfy the assumptions of the deformation theorem with respect to an appropriate metric on the domain and the round metric on the target.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 建立紧流形间具有孤立锥型奇点的调和映射变形理论，在切映射指数、零度及加权 Jacobi 核条件下证明背景度量小扰动后的持续存在。
techniques: 径向投影及 Hopf 切映射
analysis.breakthrough: 把奇异调和映射的稳定变形准则与满足条件的具体例子结合。
analysis.limitations: 要求切映射离原点光滑、多项式趋近及非退化性，不能泛称所有孤立奇点调和映射都稳定。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
